runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game spstn_l5 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <run>/state --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/system-11/spstn-<run>.json --boot-wait 0 --output <run>/run.json. The initialization run (spstn-nvram-init.json) starts from an empty state directory and stops on FACTORY SETTING; every other run starts from a new state directory holding only that run's nvram/spstn_l5.nv. Diagnostic scenarios wait 8 s, set Manual-Down (-6 = 0), pulse Advance (-7) to enter the tests, set Auto-Up (-6 = 1) and pulse Advance until the checkpoint text is displayed.

coil-test.limitation: A pulsed address is ROM activity, not proof that a load is fitted.
coil-test.note: Advance walk to COIL TEST (player 3 display 05), then two identical cycles of 28 named steps. Step:address = player 1 and 2 displays: 1:1 = OUTHOLE; 2:25 = RELNCH FLASHER; 3:2 = BALL RELEASE; 4:26 = LEFT FLASHER; 5:3 = LF BALL POPPER; 6:27 = RIGHT FLASHER; 7:4 = RT BALL POPPER; 8:28 = TOP FLASHER; 9:29 = PANEL FLASHER; 10:6 = 3 BANK; 11:30 = FLAME FLASHER; 12:7 = INSERT KNOCKER; 13:31 = STATION FLASHER; 14:8 = RIGHT DROP TG; 15:32 = LEFT DOCK; 16:9 = PLAYFLD GEN ILU; 17:10 = PLAYFLD GRN GI; 18:11 = INSERT GI; 19:12 = AC SELECT; 20:13 = LEFT REENTRY; 21:15 = PANEL LIGHTS; 22:16 = SPACE STATION; 23:17 = RIGHT DOCK; 24:18 = LEFT SLING; 25:19 = RIGHT JET; 26:20 = RIGHT SLING; 27:21 = LEFT JET; 28:22 = BOTTOM JET. The A/C select relay (12) is energized before and held through each step that pulses 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, pulsed by itself in its own AC SELECT step, and released for every other step. No step pulses 5 or 14.

gameplay.limitation: The host answers the ROM's drives with fixed, scripted switch changes; a pulse the ROM fires proves only that the address changed under these conditions, not a mechanism's travel time or the physical device's identity.

nvram-init.note: Boot to FACTORY SETTING from an empty state directory; the NVRAM written on stop is the only state later spstn_l5 runs inherit.

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes and NVRAM remain external.
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is SHA-256 of manifest.json's exact bytes. manifest.json is compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF, of {files: [{path, sha256, size}], format: 'pinmame-external-evidence-manifest', game, version: 1}; files lists every file under source.path recursively (each run's run.json, copied scenario.json, stdout and stderr logs, and every state-directory file including the inherited and written NVRAM) except manifest.json and manifest.sha256, sorted by POSIX relative path. tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py writes and re-checks it.
